exclusions: Only items tied to a 2026 regular-season home date from p0/homegames-nfl.json were counted. Pages or paths carrying 2025 (for example /gameday/2025/*, /tickets/2025/*, 2025 Salute to Service hometown hero text) were excluded by year in URL, byline date, or body text. Preseason items (August 2026, /preseason_* or /pre/ paths, 'Preseason Week N' guides) were excluded by path and date. Away-game watch parties and off-site fan fests were excluded because they are not on a home date. Rolling next-game pages were tied to a date only when the page body or its section banner named the opponent or kickoff time that matches one home date. Panthers specifics: /gameday/2025/* and 2021 game-hub promotion pages excluded by year; Week 6 watch party is an away game.
notes: The configured URL has never held gameday promos in 2026; it is a sponsor sweepstakes grid. Panthers do not publish giveaway nights.
